title: Future-proofing is dead and AI killed it
description: This thought-provoking essay examines how AI fundamentally breaks our traditional approach to building durable, future-proof systems and products. It challenges designers and product leaders to rethink long-term strategy in an era where change happens too fast to predict, offering essential perspective for anyone planning product roadmaps.

title: The attack of the giant AI design slop monster
description: A timely critical examination of how AI-generated design is degrading quality across the industry and practical strategies for maintaining design integrity in 2026. Essential reading for designers concerned about maintaining standards as generative tools proliferate.

title: Machines are trying to get gut feelings while you're telling me to ignore mine
description: A provocative exploration of how AI is learning intuition from humans while UX professionals are encouraged to dismiss their own gut instincts, raising important questions about design decision-making in the AI age. Challenges conventional wisdom about data-driven design.

title: Forward-deployed design as plumbing
description: Ron Bronson explores forward-deployed design through a fresh metaphor, examining how design teams can reduce coordination debt and ship meaningful fixes at scale. Practical insights for design leaders looking to improve team structure and cross-functional collaboration.

title: High fidelity, low definition
description: Sean Good's essay challenges the assumption that high fidelity mockups always lead to better design decisions, advocating for deliberate fidelity choices based on what you need to communicate. A valuable counterpoint for teams drowning in polished prototypes.

title: Claude Ship Can Ship Your Product
description: An insightful look at how Claude Ship goes beyond code generation to help teams ship complete products end-to-end, addressing the real gap between coding and shipping that AI tooling has overlooked until now.

title: A visual identity for Reset that adapts like its app
description: Studio Kiln's adaptive visual identity system for Reset demonstrates how modern brand design can be dynamic and responsive, mirroring app behavior rather than fighting against it. A strong case study in designing brands for digital-first products.

title: Tegaki
description: An impressive open-source handwriting animation library that generates natural, stroke-by-stroke character animations for any font—a valuable resource for designers building personalized and human-feeling digital experiences. Useful tool for projects requiring authentic handwriting effects.
